integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only the copula maximum-CDF identity, the standard Lipschitz characterization of copula diagonals, the chain rule for absolutely continuous functions, the derivative characterization of convexity, Jensen inequality, and the endpoint chord inequality for a convex generator. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The likelihood-ratio equivalence is stated for a strictly increasing absolutely continuous common margin with positive density almost everywhere. The information envelope uses convex generators finite on the interval from zero to the dimension. The result identifies only the copula diagonal, not the full dependence law. A potentially relevant 2011 likelihood-ratio-order paper was accessible only through its abstract, so an older equivalent formulation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Maximum-to-margin likelihood ratios characterize convex copula diagonals
